Global Locations 300+ Cities and industrial sites Miles Driven 14 million More than 23 million kilometres Deliveries Completed 10 million+ Groceries, hot food, industrial supplies Daily Road Crossings 125,000 2 road crossings per second OUR ROBOTS The only Physical AI proven at scale Starship robots are 99% autonomous and operate at Level 4. They have completed over 10 million deliveries — millions more than any competitor. Our robots deliver hot food, groceries and industrial supplies, using a combination of radars, cameras, sensors and machine learning to identify objects and navigate the world around them. Our Robots OUR PARTNERS Delivering the World's Biggest Brands Starship partners with grocery retailers, delivery apps and industrial sites to provide a cost-effective, sustainable delivery solution.
